Alex Morgan: Morning — quick async check-in. What I did: merged canary for continuous-batching, ran perf smoke on short sequences. Blockers: seeing a perf regression on staging for long sequences (p95/p99 increased ~30%). Today: debugging kv-cache invalidation + will review runtime CRs.

Mira Patel: Thanks Alex. Noted the regression — saw a few errored traces in tracing dashboard. Can we get a repro script? @Samir K. @Juan C. can you take a look if you have cycles?

Samir K.: On it. I can try to repro locally with the same sequence lengths. Suspect KV invalidation from the new eviction path. Will try to reproduce and open a draft PR if I can.

Samir K.: Quick local snippet I'm running to repro:```bash
# reproduce long sequence perf
python eval_harness.py --model redwood/gpt-small --seq-len 4096 --batch 1 --profile
```

Juan C.: Deployed a tiny hotfix to staging (mem guards) but still seeing OOM spikes on p3 instances when seq > 3k. Added a mem snapshot and torch summary in the harness: `torch.cuda.memory_summary()` to get better breakdown.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started (id=2141592610) model=redwood/gpt-small-quant, target=staging, initiated_by=Mira Patel. Status: in_progress.

Mira Patel: Also, standup moved from 11:00 -> 11:30 UTC today (calendar updated). Looking for someone to review PR #842 (runtime/compile) — @Alex Morgan any chance?

Alex Morgan: Will do a quick pass after coffee, aiming for review within the hour :coffee:. If we need infra scale-ups for the repro, can @eng-sre weigh in?

Samir K.: Draft PR coming in ~20m (branch: fix/kv-eviction-214159). I'll request review and add perf traces.

Mira Patel: If anyone's blocked on dependencies or access, DM me. Today I'm focused on runbook edits for canaries and the canary config UI tweaks.

Alex Morgan: TL;DR: merged canary, investigating perf regression for long sequences, will review runtime CRs, thx. :thumbsup:
